directions.en:
On the following pages you will find a series of statements about the person that you are rating now. Please read each statement and decide how much you agree or disagree with that statement. Then write your response in the space next to the statement using the following scale: 5 = strongly agree, 4 = agree, 3 = neutral (neither agree nor disagree), 2 = disagree, 1 = strongly disagree. Please answer every statement, even if you are not completely sure of your response.

Please provide the following information about the person that you will be rating: number of years you have been acquainted with this person, sex of the person being rated, and age of the person being rated.
directions.hi:
निम्न पृष्ठों में उन व्यक्ति के बारे में कथनों की एक श्रृंखला दी गई है जिसे आप अभी रेट कर रहे हैं। प्रत्येक कथन पढ़ें और निर्णय करें कि आप उससे कितना सहमत या असहमत हैं। फिर निम्न पैमाने का उपयोग कर उत्तर दें: 5 = पूर्णतः सहमत, 4 = सहमत, 3 = तटस्थ (न सहमत न असहमत), 2 = असहमत, 1 = पूर्णतः असहमत। प्रत्येक कथन का उत्तर दें, भले ही आप पूर्णतः निश्चित न हों।

मूल्यांकन से पूर्व रेट किए जा रहे व्यक्ति के बारे में ये जानकारी दें: परिचय की संवत्सर-संख्या, लिंग, आयु।

timeframe.en: General, long-standing pattern as observed by the informant (not a temporary state).

label.en: Number of years that you have been acquainted with this person
Sex of the person that you will be rating
Age of the person that you will be rating

note.en: 1 = strongly disagree, 2 = disagree, 3 = neutral (neither agree nor disagree), 4 = agree, 5 = strongly agree. Items marked R are reverse-scored.
note.hi: 1 = पूर्णतः असहमत · 2 = असहमत · 3 = तटस्थ · 4 = सहमत · 5 = पूर्णतः सहमत। 'R' चिह्नित आइटम व्युक्रम-अंकित होते हैं।

x.facetNames: Social Self-Esteem, Social Boldness, Sociability, Liveliness

rule.en: Rate each item 1-5. For every item marked R in the scoring guide, use 6 minus the response. A facet score is the MEAN of its (reversed where keyed) raw items; a domain score is the MEAN of its four facet scores. Report all scores on the 1-5 metric.
rule.hi: प्रत्येक आइटम 1-5 पर रेट होता है। पहले व्युक्रम-आइटम (R) के लिए 6 − उत्तर निकालें। प्रत्येक फलक (facet) का अंक = उसके (व्युक्रम-अंकित) आइटमों का माध्य; प्रत्येक डोमेन का अंक = अपने चार फलक-अंकों का माध्य। सभी अंक 1-5 पर रिपोर्ट हों।

interpretationNote.en: HEXACO scores are descriptive personality profiles, not diagnostic thresholds — the instrument defines no clinical cut-offs. High H-H indicates sincerity, fairness, greed avoidance and modesty; high E indicates fearfulness, anxiety, dependence and sentimentality; high X indicates social self-esteem, social boldness, sociability and liveliness; high A indicates forgiveness, gentleness, flexibility and patience; high C indicates organization, diligence, perfectionism and prudence; high O indicates aesthetic appreciation, inquisitiveness, creativity and unconventionality. Interpret observer ratings alongside — not instead of — the patient's own report, and note the informant's relationship and exposure to the subject.
interpretationNote.hi: HEXACO अंक वर्णनात्मक व्यक्तित्व-प्रोफाइल हैं — कोई नैदानिक कटऑफ नहीं। उच्च H-H = प्रामाणिकता/विनम्रता; उच्च E = भय/चिंता/निर्भरता/संवेदनशीलता; उच्च X = सामाजिक आत्मसम्मान/साहस/सामाजिकता/प्राणोद्वलन; उच्च A = क्षमा/कोमलता/लचीलापन/धैर्य; उच्च C = सुव्यवस्था/परिश्रम/परिपूर्णता/सावधानता; उच्च O = सौंदर्य/जिज्ञासा/रचनात्मकता/अपरंपरिकता। पर्यवेक्षक-रिपोर्ट रोगी-स्व-रिपोर्ट से पृथक सन्दर्भ में व्याख्या करें।

psychometrics.en: Internal-consistency reliabilities ranged .77 to .80 for college samples and .73 to .80 for community samples, with sufficient convergent validity against theoretically related scales such as the NEO Five-Factor Inventory (Ashton & Lee, 2009).
psychometrics.hi: आंतरिक सुसंगतता .77-.80 (कॉलेज नमूने) एवं .73-.80 (सामुदायिक नमूने); NEO-FFI से अभिसारी वैधता पर्याप्त (Ashton & Lee, 2009)।
